name: stripe-atmospheric
title: Stripe Atmospheric
description: Refined slate neutrals and crisp white elevation over a cool atmospheric canvas, with high-trust cobalt actions and micro-shadow depth.

typography.fontFamily: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

rules: Use the cool canvas for atmosphere and opaque white surfaces for reading and transactional work.
Layer two small shadows rather than one diffuse oversized shadow.
Cobalt identifies actions and links; slate carries layout and typography.
Keep forms in aligned single columns with persistent labels and explicit error text.
Use 8px and 12px radii for controls and cards; avoid bubble-like large sections.
Data visualizations must retain semantic meaning without relying on hue alone.
Use an asymmetric product composition with one dominant workflow, not three interchangeable cards.
Display financial values in tabular figures with currency and sign semantics.
Keep body measure below 72ch and heading line-height between 1.0 and 1.15.
Transitions target color, opacity, and transform only, with reduced-motion alternatives.
